nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership two-step handover
RoFIToken.symbol: token ticker string, set in constructor
RoFIToken.name: token display name, set in constructor
RoFIToken.decimals: token decimal places, set to 18 in constructor
RoFIToken._totalSupply: total token supply minted to the deployer-designated address in the constructor
RoFIToken.balances: mapping of token holder balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom
RoFIToken.allowed: nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance, mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom
SafeMath.safeAdd: overflow-checked addition used by transfer and transferFrom
SafeMath.safeSub: underflow-checked subtraction used by transfer and transferFrom
SafeMath.safeMul: overflow-checked multiplication (not referenced by RoFIToken)
SafeMath.safeDiv: division with zero-check (not referenced by RoFIToken)
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender
Owned.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner
Owned.acceptOwnership: requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner
RoFIToken constructor: initialises symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and credits the full supply to a hardcoded address
RoFIToken.totalSupply: returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
RoFIToken.balanceOf: returns balances[tokenOwner]
RoFIToken.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd
RoFIToken.approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without double-spend protection
RoFIToken.transferFrom: debits 'from' balance and msg.sender allowance, credits 'to' balance
RoFIToken.allowance: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
RoFIToken.approveAndCall: sets allowance then performs an external call into the spender contract
RoFIToken fallback: payable fallback that unconditionally reverts
RoFIToken.transferAnyERC20Token: onlyOwner rescue that performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowance bookkeeping
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) inside approveAndCall
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) inside transferAnyERC20Token
transfer(address to): destination of the token transfer, used to index balances
transfer(address to, uint tokens): amount moved, fed into safeSub/safeAdd
transferFrom(address from, ...): source account whose balance and allowance are debited
transferFrom(..., address to, ...): destination account credited with the tokens
transferFrom(..., uint tokens): amount moved, fed into safeSub/safeAdd
approve(address spender, ...): address granted the allowance in allowed[msg.sender]
approve(..., uint tokens): allowance amount written to allowed
approveAndCall(address spender, ...): allowance target and external call target
approveAndCall(..., uint tokens, ...): allowance amount and value passed to receiveApproval
approveAndCall(..., bytes data): arbitrary calldata forwarded to the spender contract
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, ...): arbitrary contract invoked as an ERC20
transferAnyERC20Token(..., uint tokens): amount forwarded to the external transfer call
transferOwnership(address _newOwner): pending owner stored in newOwner
transfer return value 'success', always true when execution completes
transferFrom return value 'success', always true when execution completes
approve return value 'success', always true when execution completes
approveAndCall return value 'success', true only if the external call returns
transferAnyERC20Token return value, forwards the external call's boolean result

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner inside the Owned constructor
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before staging newOwner
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting ownership
transfer uses msg.sender as the source index into balances
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] for the spender allowance
approveAndCall stores the allowance under msg.sender and forwards it to receiveApproval
approveAndCall performs an external call into the untrusted spender contract after updating allowed
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract supplied by the owner
the external token transfer sends funds to the privileged owner address
safeAdd guards the recipient balance addition in transfer against overflow
safeSub guards the sender balance subtraction in transfer against underflow
safeAdd guards the recipient balance addition in transferFrom
safeSub guards the sender balance and allowance subtraction in transferFrom
constructor writes the token symbol
constructor writes the token name
constructor writes the token decimals
constructor sets _totalSupply to the full minted amount
constructor credits the entire supply into balances of the hardcoded address
totalSupply reads _totalSupply
balanceOf reads the balances mapping
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry
transferFrom mutates balances for the from and to accounts
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in allowed
allowance reads the allowed mapping
approveAndCall writes the allowance before the external call
transferOwnership stores the pending owner in newOwner
acceptOwnership reads and clears newOwner
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner
transfer destination parameter indexes the recipient balance
transfer amount parameter is used in safeSub/safeAdd balance arithmetic
transferFrom source parameter is debited through safeSub
transferFrom destination parameter is credited through safeAdd
transferFrom amount parameter drives balance and allowance arithmetic
approve spender parameter is the allowance key
approve tokens parameter is the allowance value
approveAndCall spender parameter is both allowance key and external call target
approveAndCall tokens parameter is stored and forwarded to the untrusted callee
approveAndCall data parameter is attacker-controlled calldata passed to the external call
transferAnyERC20Token tokenAddress parameter selects the externally called contract
transferAnyERC20Token tokens parameter is forwarded to the external transfer call
transferOwnership _newOwner parameter becomes the pending owner
transfer returns the success flag
transferFrom returns the success flag
approve returns the success flag
approveAndCall returns success only if the untrusted external call returns
transferAnyERC20Token forwards the external call result
